fuelAmount.description: The amount of fuel to fill in gallons; this is the additional fuel to add to the tank. This is a float type value.

fuelLevel.description: The fuel level of the vehicle in gallons.

message.content: Engine started successfully! Fuel level is 15.0 gallons (≈57.1 liters), battery voltage is 12.6 V. All doors are locked and the brake pedal is fully engaged. Let me know what you'd like to do next—whether it's setting cruise control, adjusting climate settings, or anything else.
